 OPEN  SESSION

  Resolution  Reciting  the Facts  of the General  Municipal  Election

  The  City  Council  will  consider  adopting  a Resolution  reciting  the facts  of the General
  Municipal  Election held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, and declaring  the results  and
  such other matters  as provided  by law.
  (CLERK)

  Swearing-In  Ceremonies  for Newly  Elected  City  Officials

  The City  Council  will  consider:  (CLERK)

  Authorizing  the  administration  of  the  Oath  of  Office  (by  ballot  order)  to the  newly
  elected and re-elected  City  officials  elected  from  the  General  Municipal  Election  on
  November  8, 2022:

  City  Council  Member,  Joshua Barron;
  City  Council  Member,  Al Rios;
  City  Clerk,  Yodit  Glaze;  and
  City  Treasurer,  Jose De La Paz

  Reorganization

  The City  Council  will  consider:  (ADMIN)

  a.  Reorganizing  the Council  by nominating  and selecting  a new  Mayor  and new  Vice
  Mayor  for a one-year  term;  the selection  will  be ratified  by a majority  vote of the City
  Council;  and
  b. Authorizing  the Oaths  of Office  to be administered  to the newly  selected  Mayor  and
  Vice  Mayor.

  The South Gate Housing  Authority  will  consider:
  a.  Reorganizing  the South  Gate Housing  Authority  by nominating  and selecting  a new
  Chair  and new  Vice  Chair  for  a one-year  term;  the selection  will  be ratified  by  a
  majority  vote of the South  Gate Housing  Authority.

 SUBJECT:  RESO  UTION  RECITING  THE  FACTS  OF  THE  GENERAL
 MUNICIPAL  ELEC  ON HELD  ON TUESDAY,  NOVEMBER  8, 2022

 PURPOSE:  Upon  the  completion  of the  canvass  of votes  cast  for  the  General  Municipal
 Election  of November  8, 2022 and before  installing  the newly  elected  officers,  the City  Council
 shall  adopt  a resolution  reciting  the results  of the election.  For  a consolidated  election,  the
 governing  body  shall meet at its usual place of meeting  no later than the next regularly  scheduled
 City  Council  meeting  following  the presentation  of the canvass  of the returns.

 RECOMMENDEDACTION:  The  City  Council  will  consider  adopting  a Resolution
 reciting  the facts  of the General  Municipal  Election  held  on Tuesday,  November  8, 2022,  and
 declaring  the results  and such other matters  as provided  by law.

 FISCAL  IMPACT:  None.

 ANALYSIS:  None.

 BACKGROUND:  On July 12, 2022,  tlie City  Council  adopted  Resolution  No.  2022-34-CC,
 Calling  for the Holding  of a General  Municipal  Election  to be held  on Tuesday,  November  8,
 2022, for the Election  of Certain  Officers  and Requesting  the Board  of Supervisors  of the Corinty
 of Los Ai'igeles  to Consolidate  the Election  with  any and all Elections  also called  to be held on
 Triesday,  November  8, 2022  and Requesting  the Board  to Render  Specified  Services  to tlie City
 Relating  to the Conduct  of a General  Municipal  Election  to be held  On Tuesday,  November  8,
 2022.  The consolidation  with  the County  of Los Angeles  is pursuant  to Senate  Bill  415.  As a
 result,  the  Los  Angeles  County  Registrar  Recorder/County  Clerk's  Office  was  tasked  with
 coordinating  all  election  efforts  with  the  various  cities  holding  regularly  scheduled  General
 Municipal  Elections  on November  8, 2022.  On December  7, 2022, the Official  Certificate  of the
 Canvass  of the Election  Returns,  and the Official  Statement  of Votes  Cast by precinct,  for the

  1
 City  of South Gate General  Municipal  Election  in the County  of Los Angeles  held on November
8, 2022 was issued to the Office  of the City  Clerk.

  B.  Certificate  of Canvass  - Exhibit  "A"
  C.  Election  Tally  & Results  - Exhibit  "B"

   RESOLUTION  NO.

  CITY  OF SOUTH  GATE
  LOS  ANGELES  COUNTY,  CALIFORNIA

  RESOLUTION  OF  THE  CITY  COUNCIL  OF  THE  CITY  OF  SOUTH
  GATE,  CALIFORNIA,  RECITING  THE  FACTS  OF  THE  GENERAL
  MUNICIPAL  ELECTION  HELD  ON  TUESDAY,  NOVEMBER  8, 2022,
  DECLARING  THE  RESULTS  AND  SUCH  OTHER  MATTERS  AS
  PROVIDED  BY LAW

  WHEREAS,  a General  Municipal  Election  was held  and conducted  by the Registrar-
Recorder/County  Clerk  of the County  of Los Angeles,  on Tuesday,  November  8, 2022, as required
by law; and

  WHEREAS,  notice  of the election  was given  in time,  form,  and maru'ier  as provided  by
law; that voting  precincts  were properly  established;  that election  officers  were appointed,  and that
in all respects the election  was held and conducted,  and the votes were cast, received  and canvassed
and the returns  were made  and declared  in time,  form,  and manner  as required  by the provisions
of the Election  Code  of the State of California  for the holding  of elections  in general  law cities;
and

  WHEREAS,  the Los  Angeles  County  Registrar  Recorder/County  Clerk  conducted  the
election  and canvassed  the returns  of the election  and has certified  the results  to the City  of South
Gate on December  7, 2022  and the results  are received,  attached  hereto  as Exhibit  "A"  and made
a part of this Resolution.

NOW,  THEREFOR,  THE  CITY  COUNCIL  OF  THE  CITY  OF  SOUTH  GATE,
CALIFRONIA  DOES  HEREBY  RESOLVE  AS FOLLOWS:

SECTION  1. The City  Council  hereby  declares  the whole  number  of ballots  cast in the precincts
except  vote by mail ballots  is 2,520,  and that the whole  number  of vote by mail  ballots  cast in the
City  is 9,176 making  a total  of 11,696  ballots  cast in the City.

SECTION  2. The City  Council  hereby  declares  the names of the persons  voted  for at the election
for Members  of the City  Council  are as follows  (in the order of placement  of the ballot):

  Joshua Barron
  Al Rios
  Adolfo  Varas
  Ruby  M. Navarro
  Robert  Montalvo
  Jovanna  Laborin

SECTION  3. The City  Council  hereby  declares  the names of the persons  voted  for at the election
for City  Clerk  are as follows  (in the order of placement  on the ballot):

  Page l of 3
   Yodit  Glaze

SECTION  4. The City  Council  hereby  declares  the names of the persons  voted  for at the election
for City  Treasurer  are as follows  (in the order of placement  on the ballot):

  Jose De La Paz
  Greg Martinez

SECTION  5. The City Council  hereby  declares  for the submission  to the voters  a question  relating
to Business  License  Tax Measure:

  Business  License  Tax Measure.  To assist in maintaining  public  safety, repair  Yes
  streets, maintain  parks, services for seniors, and other general city services,  shall
  the annual  taxes and solid  waste  processing  fees paid  by Material  Recovery
  PD  Facilities be increased to $500 plus $1.94 per ton and annual CPI adjustment,  No
  and provide for increases every three years to all other Business License Taxes
  based on cost of living  increases,  as measured  by the Consumer  Price Index
  (CPI),  be adopted?

SECTION  6. The City  Council  hereby  declares  the number  of votes given  at each precinct  and
the number  of votes given  in the City for each of the persons  above named for the respective  offices
or which  the persons  were  candidates,  and for and against  the measure  as listed  in Exhibit  "B"
which  is attached  hereto  and made a part of this Resolution.

SECTION  7. The City  Council  hereby  declares  and determines  (in the order of placement  on the
ballot)  that:  Joshua  Barron  was elected  as Member  of the City  Council  for the full  term  of four
years;  Al Rios  was elected  as Member  of the City  Council  for the full  term of four  years;  Yodit
Glaze was elected  as City  Clerk  for the full  term of four years;  and Jose De La Paz was elected  as
City Treasurer  for the full  term of four years.

SECTION  8. The City  Council  hereby  directs  the City  Clerk  to enter on the records  of the City
Council  of the City,  a statement  of the results  of the election,  showing:  (1) the whole  number  of
ballots  cast in the City;  (2) the names of the persons  voted for; (3) for what office  each person  was
voted  for;  (4) the number  of votes  given  at each precinct  to each person,  (5) the name  of the
measure  voted  for; and (6) the total number  of votes.

SECTION  9. The  City  Clerk  shall  attest  to  and  certify  the  passage  and  adoption  of  this
Resolution,  which  shall be effective  upon its adoption.

SUBJECT:  SWEARING-IN  ONIES  FOR  NEWLY  ELECTED  CITY  OFFICIALS

PURPOSE:  The purpose  of this  item  is to conduct  the Oaths  of Office  to the newly  elected  and
re-elected  City  officials.

RECOMMENDED  ACTIONS:  The City  Council  will  consider:
Authorizing  the administration  of the Oath  of Office  (by ballot  order)  to the newly  elected  and re-
elected  City  officials  elected  from  the General  Municipal  Election  on November  8, 2022:
  a.  City  Council  Member,  Joshua Barron;
  b.  City  Council  Member,  Al Rios;
  c.  City  Clerk,  Yodit  Glaze;  and
  d.  City  Treasurer,  Jose De La Paz

FISCAL  IMPACT:  None

BACKGROUND:  The General  Municipal  Election  was held on Tuesday,  November  8, 2022,  and
on the ballot  were two  positions  for City  Council,  one for City  Clerk  and one for City  Treasurer.
Prior  to the swearing-in  ceremonies,  the City  Council  will  consider  adopting  a Resolution  reciting
the fact of the General  Municipal  Election  and declaring  the results.  The Oaths  of Office  will  be
administered  immediately  thereafter.

ATTACHMENT(S):  None

SUBJECT:  CITY  COUNCIL  RE-ORGANIZATION  AND  OATHS  OF OFFICE

PURPOSE:  To allow  the City  Council  to select a new Mayor  and new Vice  Mayor  for a term of
one year.

RECOMMENDED  ACTIONS:
The City  Council  will  consider:
  a.  Reorganizing  the  Council  by  nominating  and  selecting  a new  Mayor  and  new  Vice
  Mayor  for a one-year  term;  the selection  will  be ratified  by a majority  vote  of the City
  Council;  and
  b.  Authorizing  the Oaths  of Office  to be administered  to the newly  selected  Mayor  and Vice
  Mayor.
The South Gate Housing  Authority  will  consider:
  a.  Reorganizing  the South  Gate Housing  Authority  by nominating  and selecting  a new Chair
  and new Vice  Chair  for a one-year  term;  the selection  will  be ratified  by a majority  vote
  of the South  Gate Housing  Authority.
The Successor  Agency  to the Community  Development  Commission  of the City  of South  Gate
will  consider:
  a.  Reorganizing  the Successor  Agency  to the Community  Development  Commission  of the
  City  of South  Gate by nominating  and selecting  a new  Chair  and new  Vice  Chair  for a
  one-year  term;  the selection  will  be ratified  by a majority  vote of the Successor  Agency
  to the Community  Development  Commission.
The South Gate Utility  Authority  will  consider:
  a.  Reorganizing  the South  Gate Utility  Authority  by nominating  and selecting  a new Chair
  and new Vice  Chair  for a one-year  term;  the selection  will  be ratified  by a majority  vote
  of the South  Gate Utility  Authority.
The South Gate Finance  Authority  will  consider:

  1
   a.  Reorganizing  the South  Gate Finance  Authority  by nominating  and selecting  a new Chair
  and new Vice  Chair  for a one-year  term;  the selection  will  be ratified  by a majority  vote
  of the South  Gate Finance  Authority.
The South  Gate Public  Access  Corporation  will  consider:
  a.  Reorganizing  the South  Gate Public  Access  Corporation  by nominating  and selecting  a
  new  Chair  and new  Vice  Chair  for  a one-year  term;  the selection  will  be ratified  by a
  majority  vote of the South  Gate Public  Access  Corporation.

FISCAL  IMPACT:  There  is no fiscal  impact.

ANALYSIS:

BACKGROUND:  The nomination  and selection  of a new Mayor  and Vice  Mayor  and selection
of  a Chair  and  Vice  Chair  for  the  various  City  bodies  generally  occurs  after  a Municipal
Election.  On December  7, 2022,  the Official  Certificate  of the Canvass  of the Election  Returns
and  the  Official  Statement  of  Votes  Cast  by  precinct  for  the  City  of  South  Gate  General
Municipal  Election  in the County  of Los Angeles  held  on November  8, 2022  was issued  to the
Office  of the Clerk  and a Resolution  reciting  the results  of the election  was approved  as per the
provisions  provided  by the South  Gate Municipal  Code.

ATTACHMENT(S):  None

  THURSDAY, DECEMBER 8, 2022
CALL TO ORDER  The Special Joint meeting of the City Council, Housing Authority,
  Successor Agency, Utility Authority, Public Finance Authority and Public
  Access Corporation was called to order by Maria del Pilar Avalos, Vice
  Mayor/Vice Chairperson at 6:49 p.m.

ROLL CALL  Yodit Glaze, City Clerk

PRESENT  Vice Mayor/Vice Chair Maria del Pilar Avalos, Council/Authority/Agency
  Member/Director Maria Davila, Council/Authority/Agency
  Member/Director Gil Hurtado; City Treasurer Gregory Martinez, City
  Manager/ Executive Chris Jeffers, City Attorney/Authority Counsel Raul
  F. Salinas

ABSENT  Mayor/Chairperson Al Rios and Council/Authority/Agency Member/
  Director Denise Diaz

  At this time Council/Authority/Agency Member/Director Hurtado stated
  that he would like to continue with Items 1 and 2 but continue Item 3 to
  the meeting of December 13th at 6:00 p.m.

  Raul F. Salinas, City Attorney recommended that since these items were
  agenized on tonight's meeting, we should take care of Items 1 and 2.
  When we get to agenda Item 2 we can make the same announcement that
  there is a request to continue Item 3 and open to the public for comment.

  Council/Authority/Agency Member/Director Davila agreed with Mr.
  Salinas and would like to move forward with Items 1 and 2.

1
ELECTION ADMIN  The City Council adopted Resolution No. 2022-70-CC entitled -
  Resolution of the City Council of the City of South Gate, California,
  reciting the facts of the General Municipal Election held on Tuesday,
  November 8, 2022, and declaring the results and such other matters as
  provided by law, by motion of Council/Authority/Agency Member/
  Director Davila and seconded by Vice Mayor/Vice Chair Avalos.

CONT'D  ROLL CALL: Council/Authority/Agency Member/Director Davila, yes;
  Council/Authority/Agency Member/Director Hurtado, yes; Vice
  Mayor/Vice Chair Avalos, yes; Council/Authority/Agency
  Member/Director Diaz, absent; Mayor/Chair Rios, absent.

  City Treasurer Greg Martinez questioned if by holding this meeting would
  it be considered a Brown Act Violation due to the time that the agenda
  was posted.

  Raul F. Salinas, City Attorney stated that there is no specific case
  judicially that will address this specific issue. He suggested that the City
  Council acknowledge the individuals that are going to be assuming office
  during tonight's meeting. Then City Council would continue the meeting
  to December 13th at 6:00 p.m. to reaffirm the action taken on tonight's
  agenda allowing the City Council to move forward with the remainder of
  tonight's agenda.

2

  ballot order) to the newly elected and re-elected City officials elected from
  the General Municipal Election on November 8, 2022: (Mayor Rios was
  absent)

  a.  City Council Member, Joshua Barron;
  b.  City Council Member, Al Rios;
  c.  City Clerk, Yodit Glaze; and
  d.  City Treasurer, Jose De La Paz

  and new Vice Mayor for a one-year term; the selection will be ratified

  b. Authorizing the Oaths of Office to be administered to the newly
  selected Mayor and Vice Mayor.
  The South Gate Housing Authority will consider:

  a. Reorganizing the South Gate Housing Authority by nominating and
  selecting a new Chair and new Vice Chair for a one-year term; the
  selection will be ratified by a majority vote of the South Gate Housing
  Authority.
